sections.title: Advanced Topics in Monitoring & Evaluation in IED
sections.description: This is a sequel to the Principles of M&E course offered in the fall. The course will review both theories as well as methods of program evaluation in a deeper way using papers and technical reports as case studies, with special emphasis on international education development.
